title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
english: A Russian jet-powered drone strike on a crowded railway station in Dnipro has killed at least 14 people and injured many others. The attack hit a platform where a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhia was waiting, prompting President Zelensky to demand stricter international sanctions against Russia. Meanwhile, a separate missile attack in Chernihiv resulted in the deaths of two teenage girls and left several others wounded.
amharic: በዩክሬን ዲኒፕሮ ከተማ በሚገኝ የባቡር ጣቢያ ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ተሳፋሪዎችን እየጠበቀ በነበረ ባቡር ላይ ሲሆን፣ የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በሩሲያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ማዕቀቦች እንዲጣሉ ጠይቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ በቼርኒሂቭ ከተማ በተፈጸመ ሌላ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ሁለት ታዳጊ ልጃገረዶች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Hujii roonii (drone) Ruusiyaan magaalaa Dniprotti buufata baaburaa irratti raawwatte keessaatti namoonni 14 ol du’anii, hedduun immoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun baabura imaltoota gara Zaaporiizhizhiyaa geeffuuf eeggachaa ture irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta’u, pirezidaant Zeelenskiin tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun mootummoonni biyyoota alaa adabbii Ruusiyaatti laaffisan jabeessuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
english: Following his recent election defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Flávio Bolsonaro has declared himself the leader of Brazil while traveling in the United States. Despite lacking evidence, he claims the election was fraudulent and is refusing to accept the official results. Bolsonaro also defied a Supreme Court order to surrender his passports before leaving the country, sparking further controversy regarding his legal standing.

oromo: Flaviio Bolsonaaroon erga filannoo kana injifatamanii booda, yeroo ammaa Amerikaa keessa jiruun ofiin of waamicha gochuun geggeessaa biyyaatii jedhaniiru. Ragaa tokko malee filannichi sobaa fi gowwoomsaadhaan guutameera jechuun bu'aa filannoo sana fudhachuu didaniiru. Kana malees, qorannoo maallaqa seeraan alaa waliin walqabatee paaspoortii isaanii akka kennan ajaja mana murtii olaanaa irraa kennameef osoo hin raawwatin biyyaa bahuun isaanii mormii cimaa kaaseera.

title: Israel’s anti-Qatar campaign bleeds into elections
english: As Israel awaits final election results, some Israeli political figures have accused Qatar of interfering in the process by funding Arab parties. Qatar’s Foreign Ministry has strongly denied these allegations, dismissing them as a baseless disinformation campaign designed to involve them in internal Israeli disputes. While these claims circulate, Israeli election officials have not supported the accusations, and the primary political groups continue to face uncertainty regarding their parliamentary majority.
amharic: እስራኤል የምርጫ ውጤት በምትጠባበቅበት ወቅት፣ አንዳንድ የእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ኳታር ለአረብ ፓርቲዎች የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በማድረግ በምርጫው ጣልቃ እየገባች ነው የሚል ክስ አቅርበዋል። የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ሀገሪቱን በእስራኤል የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ለመክተት የታቀደ መሰረት የሌለው የሀሰት ወሬ ዘመቻ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ክሶች ቢሰሙም፣ የእስራኤል የምርጫ ኮሚቴ የሰጠው አስተያየት የለም እና ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምፅ ለማግኘት አሁንም አዳጋች ሁኔታ ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Israa'el bu'aa filannoo eeggachaa jirtu kanaan, namoonni siyaasaa Israa'el tokko tokko Qaatar paartilee Arabaaf maallaqa kennuun filannoo keessa seenuuf yaaltee jiru jedhanii himatu. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Qaatar himannaa kana guutumaatti kan haale yoo ta'u, himannichi siyaasa biyya keessaa Israa'el keessatti isaan hirmaachisuuf odeeffannoo sobaa babal'isuu akka ta'e ibseera. Himannaan kun babal'atus, qondaalonni filannoo Israa'el ragaa kana deggaran hin kennine, akkasumas paartileen siyaasaa gurguddoon akkaataa ganda guutuu (Knesset) keessatti harka caalu argachuun itti ulfaatee itti fufu jira.

title: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train collision
english: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego, aged 24, was identified as one of the at least 68 victims in a tragic high-speed train collision in Toledo province. The crash occurred on a line connecting Madrid to Andalusia and also left dozens of passengers with serious injuries. Officials and the Spanish athletics community have expressed deep sorrow over the loss of the promising young athlete.
amharic: የ24 ዓመቷ የስፔን የረጅም ዝላይ አትሌት ጁሊዬታ ጋሌጎ በቶሌዶ ግዛት በተከሰተው የባቡር ግጭት ህይወታቸው ካለፈው ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎች መካከል አንዷ መሆኗ ተረጋግጧል። አደጋው የደረሰው ማድሪድን ወደ ደቡብ አንዳልூዚያ በሚያገናኘው የባቡር መስመር ላይ ሲሆን በርካታ ተሳፋሪዎችም ለከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተዳርገዋል። የስፔን የአትሌቲክስ ፌዴሬሽን እና ሌሎች የስፖርት ቤተሰቦች ለወጣቷ አትሌት ህልፈት ጥልቅ ሀዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Atleetii utaaltoo dheeraa kan Ispeen kan taate Julieta Gallego, umriin ishee waggaa 24, balaa baaburaa naannoo Toledo keessatti namoota 68 ol du'an keessatti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Balaan kun kan mudate sarara baaburaa Maadrid fi Andalusiya walqabsiisu irratti yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduun ammoo miidhaa cimaan irra ga'eera. Federeeshiniin Atleetiksii Ispeen fi hawaasni ispoortii gadda guddaa isaan itti dhaga'ame ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes hit Gaza as Health Ministry urges Rafah opening
english: Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in further casualties, including a drone attack on a vehicle in the Maghazi refugee camp that left two people dead. Meanwhile, Gaza's health officials are urgently calling for the opening of the Rafah crossing to evacuate severely injured patients who cannot receive proper care locally. These ongoing attacks, which include artillery shelling and home demolitions, continue to devastate infrastructure and displace families across the territory.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ተጨማሪ የሰው ህይወት እየቀጠፈ ሲሆን፣ በማጋዚ የስደተኞች ካምፕ በተሽከርካሪ ላይ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ የሟቾች ቁጥር ጨምሯል። የጋዛ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው ህክምና ማግኘት ያልቻሉ በጠና የታመሙ ታካሚዎችን ወደ ውጭ ሀገር ለመላክ እንዲቻል የራፋህ መተላለፊያ እንዲከፈት በአስቸኳይ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። ቀጣይነት ያለው የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባ እና የመኖሪያ ቤቶች መፍረስ በክልሉ ያለውን መሰረተ ልማት እያወደመ ሲሆን ስደተኞችንም ለከፍተኛ ችግር እየዳረገ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el Gaza keessatti haleellaa geggeessaa jiruun lubbuun namoota dabalataa darbeera; keessumaa, qubsuma baqattoota Maghaazii keessatti konkolaataa tokko irratti haleellaa xiyyaara kajeellaan (drone) geggeeffameen namoonni lama ajjeefamaniiru. Qaamoleen fayyaa Gaza, namoota miidhaan cimaan irra ga'ee achuma keessatti wal'aanamuu hin dandeenye biyyoota alaatti erguf daandiin Rafah akka banamu gaafachaa jiru. Haleellaan itti fufiinsaan geggeeffamaa jiru kun, kan of keessatti qabatu dhukaasa waraanaa fi diiggaa manneenii, bu'uuraalee misoomaa barbadeessuun baqattoota biroos rakkoo hamaaf saaxilaa jira.

title: As US midterms approach, farmers decide what to plant and how to vote
english: Farmers across the United States are struggling with increased operational costs and climate-related challenges, forcing them to change their planting strategies. As the midterm elections approach, these economic pressures are influencing how agricultural communities plan to vote. Political experts are closely watching rural districts, as high prices and shifting loyalties could impact the balance of power in Congress.

title: YouTube star Jake Paul returns to boxing after Joshua loss for Dubai fight
english: YouTube star and professional boxer Jake Paul is set to make his return to the ring on December 24 in Dubai. This will be his first match following a severe jaw injury sustained during a knockout loss to Anthony Joshua last year. While Paul is actively preparing for the event, his opponent for the Christmas Eve fight has not yet been named.

title: Obama and Trump spar at rallies in Georgia and Ohio: Key takeaways
english: Former President Barack Obama and President Donald Trump held competing campaign rallies in Georgia and Ohio just days before the midterm elections. Obama heavily criticized the current administration for its involvement in the ongoing conflict with Iran and the economic consequences, such as rising fuel and consumer prices. He also challenged Trump's trade policies, arguing that the implemented tariffs have failed to provide the promised economic growth and instead increased costs for citizens.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ እና ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ መካከለኛ የምርጫ ዘመን ሊጠናቀቅ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀሩት በጆርጂያ እና በኦሃዮ ተቃራኒ የቅስቀሳ ሰልፎችን አካሂደዋል። ኦባማ የአሁኑ አስተዳደር ከአይራን ጋር በገባበት ጦርነት እና በውስንነት ምክንያት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ እና የሸቀጦች ዋጋ ክፉኛ ተችተዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ትራምፕ የጣሏቸው የንግድ ታሪፎች የገባላቸውን የኢኮኖሚ ጥቅም ሳያመጡ በዜጎች ላይ የኑሮ ውድነት ማምጣታቸውን በማንሳት ተችተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Baraak Obaamaa fi Pirezedantiin Doonaald Tiraamp guyyoota muraasa filannoo giddu galeessaatti hafan gidduutti mootummaa Ohaayoo fi Joorjiyaa keessatti wal-morkii siyaasaa taasisaa jiru. Obaamaa, mootummaan ammaa waraana Iraan waliin jalqabamee fi gatiin boba'aa fi meeshaalee gabaa keessatti ol ka'uun isaa hammeenya hojii isaa ta'uu dubbate. Akkasumas, sirni gibiraa Tiraamp hojii irra oolche bu'aa diinagdee waadaa galame hin argamsiisne, kanaa mannaa gatii meeshaalee irratti dabaluun ummata miidheera jechuun qeeqe.

title: Are Texans divided over Republican and Democrat candidates?
english: As the U.S. midterm elections approach, voters in Texas are expressing a variety of perspectives regarding the political divide between Republican and Democratic candidates. During a campaign event for Ken Paxton, supporters shared their thoughts on the upcoming contest against his Democratic challenger, James Talarico. The report highlights how Texans are actively weighing their options and considering the significant differences between the competing political parties.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ጊዜ ምርጫ እየተቃረበ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት የቴክሳስ መራጮች በሪፐብሊካን እና በዴሞክራት እጩዎች መካከል ስላለው ልዩነት የተለያዩ አመለካከቶችን እያንጸባረቁ ነው። በሪፐብሊካኑ እጩ በኬን ፓክስተን የቅስቀሳ መድረክ ላይ፣ ደጋፊዎች በዴሞክራቱ ተፎካካሪ ጀምስ ታላሪኮ ላይ ያላቸውን የተለያየ አመለካከት ገልጸዋል። ዘገባው የቴክሳስ ነዋሪዎች ምርጫቸውን ለመወሰን በተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት በቁም ነገር እየተመለከቱ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa Amerikaa yeroo dhiyaatutti, jiraattonni Texas wal-qoodinsa siyaasaa qindeeffannoo Rippabilikaanii fi Dimookiraatoota gidduu jiru irratti ilaalcha garaagaraa qabu. Ayyaana walgahii ummataa kan kaadhimamaa Rippabilikaanii Ken Paxton irratti, deggertoonni morkataa isaanii kan Dimookiraata James Talarico ilaalchisee yaada garaagaraa kennaniiru. Gabaasichi jiraattonni Texas filannoo isaanii murteessuuf garaagarummaa paartilee siyaasaa kanaa gadi fageenyaan ilaalaa akka jiran ibsa.

title: European Union backtracks on Canada becoming ‘associate member’
english: The European Union has decided against granting Canada the status of an 'associate member' ahead of an upcoming summit in Montreal. While EU leaders initially explored this idea to strengthen ties, opposition from several member nations, including Germany, led to the removal of this language from official documents. Instead, both sides are focusing on practical cooperation, such as joint infrastructure projects and energy initiatives, to deepen their partnership.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት በሞንትሪያል በሚካሄደው ጉባኤ ዋዜማ ካናዳን 'ተባባሪ አባል' የማድረግ እቅዱን ሰርዟል። ህብረቱ ግንኙነቱን ለማጠናከር ይህንን ሀሳብ አንስቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የጀርመንን ጨምሮ የበርካታ አባል ሀገራት ተቃውሞ በመግጠሙ ቃሉ ከይፋዊ መግለጫዎች እንዲወገድ ተደርጓል። በምትኩ፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች የጋራ የመሰረተ ልማት እና የኢነርጂ ስምምነቶችን በመፈራረም የጠበቀ ትብብር ለመፍጠር ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa gaaffii Kaanaadaan 'miseensa gargaaraa' akka taatuuf ture marii mootummootaa biyyattii irratti ka'e booda haqeera. Gamtichi hariiroo isaa cimsuuf yaada kana kaasee kan ture ta'us, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an hedduun, keessumaa Jarman, mormii isaanii ibsuun jechi kun barreeffama waliinii irraa akka haqamu godhaniiru. Kanaa mannaa, gamachuun lamaan kun dhimmoota bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi gabaa anniisaa irratti waliigaltee uumuun hariiroo isaanii gara fuulduraatti akka cimsu irratti xiyyeeffataniiru.

title: Bayern celebrate Kane’s Ballon d’Or, Kompany’s discharge with Magdeburg win
english: Bayern Munich secured a comfortable 6-1 victory over Magdeburg in the German Cup despite resting newly crowned Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane. The team was managed by assistant Aaron Danks, as head coach Vincent Kompany was recently discharged from the hospital after a medical collapse. Bayern celebrated Kane’s historic achievement with a guard of honor before focusing on their upcoming key matches against Borussia Dortmund and Atletico Madrid.
amharic: ባየር ሙኒክ የጀርመን ዋንጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር ጨዋታ ላይ ማግደበርግን 6 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር አልፈዋል። የባሎንዶር አሸናፊው ሃሪ ኬን በጨዋታው እረፍት የተደረገለት ሲሆን፣ ዋና አሰልጣኙ ቪንሰንት ኮምፓኒ በህክምና ክትትል ላይ ከቆዩ በኋላ ከሆስፒታል ተፈትተዋል። ቡድኑ በመጪው ቅዳሜ ከቦሩሲያ ዶርትሙንድ ጋር ለሚጠብቀው ወሳኝ ጨዋታ በመዘጋጀት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Bayern Munich tapha waancaa Jarmanii irratti Magdeburg 6-1 injifachuun gara sadarkaa itti aanutti darbaniiru. Injifattoon badhaasa Ballon d'Or Harry Kane taphicha irratti boqonnaa kan argate yoo ta'u, leenjisaan isaanii Vincent Kompany rakkoo fayyaa booda hospitaala irraa gadhiifamaniiru. Bayern qophii tapha boqonnaa torban dhufu Borussia Dortmund waliin taasisan irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru.

title: ‘I held this woman in my arms. She died’: Spain mourns train crash victims
english: A devastating high-speed train collision in central Spain has resulted in 68 deaths and dozens of injuries. The tragedy occurred when a passenger train struck a stationary locomotive, leading to intense national grief and a formal investigation. Because this is the second major crash on this specific rail line in less than a year, citizens and officials are now questioning the adequacy of railway maintenance and safety standards.
amharic: በስፔን መካከለኛ ክፍል በሁለት ባቡሮች መጋጨት ምክንያት 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው የሳር ባቡር የቆመ ባቡርን ሲገጭ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። በአንድ አመት ውስጥ በዚህ የባቡር መስመር ላይ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ አደጋ መከሰቱ፣ የባቡር መስመሩ ደህንነት እና የጥገና ስራዎች በአግባቡ እየተከናወኑ እንደሆነ በስፔን ህዝብ ዘንድ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Speni giddugaleessaatti balaa gurguddaa baaburaa lama walitti bu’aniin lubbuun namoota 68 darbeera, namoonni hedduunis miidhaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate baaburrii imaltootaa baabura dhaabbataa ture tokko rukutee booda yoo ta’u, mootummaanis qorannoo jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti karaa baaburaa kana irratti balaan lammaffaa mudachuu isaatiin, nageenyi karaa baaburaa fi hojiin suphaa gaaffii keessa galaniiru.

title: US elections: Republicans are betting on Islamophobia to win the midterms
english: The Republican Party is increasingly using Islamophobic rhetoric as a core campaign strategy ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Officials are openly spreading anti-Muslim sentiment and promoting policies focused on deportation, shifting away from subtle political tactics to direct hostility. This institutionalized bias is being utilized to distract from low approval ratings and economic concerns while hardening public division.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ መጪውን የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ለማሸነፍ ኢስላማዊ ጥላቻን እንደ ዋና የቅስቀሳ ስልት እየተጠቀመበት ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደባባይ የሙስሊም ጥላቻን በመስበክ እና የውጭ ዜጎችን የማባረር ፖሊሲዎችን በማራመድ ከቀድሞው የፖለቲካ ጨዋታ በተለየ መልኩ ግልጽ ጥቃቶችን እየሰነዘሩ ነው። ይህ ተቋማዊ የሆነ የጥላቻ አካሄድ መንግስት ዝቅተኛ ተቀባይነት ካለው እና ከኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ትኩረትን ለመቀየር እንዲሁም ህዝብን ለመከፋፈል ታቅዶ የሚሰራ ነው።
oromo: Paartiin Rippablikan filannoo giddu galeessaatti injifachuuf jecha jibba Islaamummaarratti hundaa'e tooftaa duula filannoo isaanii godhachaa jiru. Hoggantoonni paartichaa ifatti jibba Muslimootaa babal'isaa fi imaammata arii'anii baasuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuun, akka kanaan duraa osoo hin taane, ifatti diinummaa calaqqisiisaa jiru. Akkaataan jibba ijaarsa qabaate kun, mootummaan fudhatama dhabuufi rakkoo dinagdee irraa xiyyeeffannoo akka jijjiirran, akkasumas ummata akka wal-qoodu taasisuuf qophaaye dha.

title: Morning update
english: A ship has been reported on fire near the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran claims it shot down a US drone in the same area. Amidst these regional tensions, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed a top military planner. Additionally, Saudi Arabian forces successfully intercepted a ballistic missile fired by Houthi rebels.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አቅራቢያ አንድ መርከብ በእሳት መያያዙ ተዘግቧል፤ ኢራንም በአካባቢው የአሜሪካ ድሮን እንደመታች ገልጻለች። በእነዚህ የክልሉ ውጥረቶች መካከል የአሜሪካ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴት ከፍተኛ የጦር እቅድ አውጪን ከስራ አሰናብተዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሳውዲ አረቢያ ሃይሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተተኮሰ ባለስቲክ ሚሳይል መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Handhuura Hormuzitti markabni tokko ibiddaan miidhamee akka jiru gabaafameera; Iranis naannoo sanatti xiyyara nama hin feene kan Ameerikaa rukuttee kuffisuu ishee ibsiteetti. Walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kanaan wal-qabatee, Ministirri Ittisa Ameerikaa Pete Hegseth gorsaa waraanaa olaanaa hojiirraa ari'aniiru. Gama biraatiin, humnoonni Sa'udii Arabaa misayila 'ballistic' finxaaleyyii Huutii irraa dhukaafame akka fashaleessan beekameera.

title: Attacks reportedly target Yemen’s Dhaw Bab, Mocha
english: Multiple air strikes have reportedly hit the Dhaw Bab and Mocha districts in Yemen. These attacks were announced by media organizations associated with the Houthi movement. Further details regarding casualties or the extent of the damage have not yet been provided.
amharic: በየመን የዳው ባብ እና ሞቻ ወረዳዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ድብደባዎች መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህንን መረጃ ያሰራጩት ከሁቲዎች ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ናቸው። ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሟቾች ቁጥር እስካሁን የተገለጸ ዝርዝር መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Godinaalee Yemen kan ta'an Dhaw Baab fi Mocha irratti haleellaan xiyyaaraa gaggeeffamuu gabaafameera. Haleellaa kana kan gabaasan miidiyaaleen garee Hutiin walqabatanidha. Miidhaa namoota irra ga'e ykn gubaa qabeenyaa irratti hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon bal'aan hin kennamne.

title: South Korea says considering deployment options to Hormuz Strait
english: South Korea is currently evaluating various ways to assist in the Strait of Hormuz, such as potentially deploying maritime surveillance planes. Officials confirmed that they are coordinating with the United States to explore these options. However, they explicitly stated that they will not be sending combat troops to the region.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ሊኖራት ስለሚችለው ተሳትፎ የተለያዩ አማራጮችን እያጤነች ሲሆን፣ ከነዚህም መካከል የባህር ላይ የስለላ አውሮፕላኖችን መላክ አንዱ ነው። ሀገሪቱ ጉዳዩን ከአሜሪካ ጋር እየተወያየችበት መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ነገር ግን ምንም አይነት የውጊያ ኃይል እንደማትልክ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Koree Kibbaas daangaa Hormuz keessatti hirmaannaa gochuu danda'uuf mala adda addaa xiinxalaa jira, kanaanis xiyyaarota qilleensa irraa hordofan erguun mala tokko ta'uu danda'a. Mootummaan biyyattii dhimma kana irratti Ameerikaa wajjin mari'achaa akka jiru kan ibsan yoo ta'u, garuu loltoota waraanaa akka hin ergine mirkaneessaniiru.

title: UKTMO: Vessel reported on fire in Hormuz Strait, off the coast of Oman
english: A ship was reported to be on fire in the Strait of Hormuz near the coast of Oman on Thursday. A nearby vessel witnessed the incident, but details regarding the safety of the crew remain unclear. Authorities have not yet released any information about the extent of the damage or potential environmental threats.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ አንድ መርከብ በእሳት መያያዙ ተዘግቧል። ሌላ መርከብ እሳቱን እንደተመለከተ የገለጸ ቢሆንም፣ በመርከቡ ላይ ስለነበሩት ሰራተኞች ደህንነት እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም። ባለስልጣናት በደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም በአካባቢው ላይ ስላለው ስጋት እስካሁን ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa garaa garbaa Hormuz kan qarqara biyya Omaan irratti argamuutti bidiruu tokko irratti ibiddayyuun gabaafameera. Bidiruun biraa tokko ibidda kana akka arge ibseera, ta'us haalli hojjettoota bidiruu sanaa hanga ammaatti ifa miti. Aangeyyoonni miidhaa qaqqabe ykn balaa naannoo irratti uumame ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti odeeffannoo tokko hin kennine.

title: Serbians storm TV studio as pro-Vucic media faces reckoning
english: Following a shift in power caused by student-led protests during national elections, protesters in Serbia entered a television studio to confront its leadership. This event occurred alongside a rare apology from a regional broadcaster regarding its history of biased coverage. These developments suggest a potential turning point for media independence in the country.
amharic: በአገራዊ ምርጫ ወቅት በተማሪዎች የተመራ ተቃውሞ ሥልጣን ላይ ለውጥ ካመጣ በኋላ፣ በሰርቢያ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች ወደ አንድ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ በመግባት የጣቢያውን ኃላፊዎች ተጋፍጠዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም፣ አንድ የክልል መገናኛ ብዙኃን ለዓመታት ሲያሰራጭ የነበረውን አድልዎ የሞላበት ዘገባ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ነፃነት ረገድ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ሊከፍቱ እንደሚችሉ ተስፋ ተጥሎባቸዋል።
oromo: Filannoo biyyaalessaa keessatti sochiin barattootaa aangoorraa jijjiirama fiduu hordofee, namoonni Serbiyaa keessatti mormii dhageessisaa turan gara istuudiyoo televijiinii tokkootti seenuudhaan hooggantoota isaa gaafatan. Haalli kun kan ta'e, miidiyaan naannoo tokko gabaasa isaa kan kanaan duraa isa wal-hin fakkaanneef dhiifama erga gaafatee booda dha. Tarkaanfileen kunniin bilisummaa miidiyaa biyyattii keessatti jijjiirama haaraa fiduu danda'a jedhamee abdhatama.

title: Bolsonaro in Miami: I am the ‘true president-elect’
english: Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of the former Brazilian leader, recently claimed on social media that he is the legitimate winner of the country's presidential election. This statement was posted while he was in Miami, shortly after his father lost the official vote to Lula da Silva. The message was later removed from the platform following the initial controversy.
amharic: የቀድሞው የብራዚል መሪ ልጅ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በቅርቡ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ባሰራጨው መልዕክት እራሱን እንደ ሀገሪቱ ህጋዊ ፕሬዝዳንት አሸናፊ አድርጎ ገልጿል። አባቱ በሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ወደ ማያሚ ያመራው ፍላቪዮ፣ ይህን መግለጫ በአሜሪካ ሆኖ ነው የሰጠው። ይሁን እንጂ መግለጫው ከተሰጠ በኋላ ብዙም ሳይቆይ ከድረ-ገጹ ላይ ተነስቷል።
oromo: Ilmi hogganaa duraanii kan Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro, ergaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti baaseen ofii isaa mo'ataa filannoo biyyattii dhugaa ta'uu isaa dubbateera. Aabba isaa filannoo Lula da Silva irratti erga mo'atamanii booda gara maayami kan imale Flavio, ibsa kana kan kenne yeroo biyya Ameerikaa turetti dha. Haa ta'u malee, ibsi kun erga bahee booda utuu hin turin marsariitii sanarraa haqameera.

title: Riot police deployed in Madrid as protests erupt over deadly train crash
english: Protests broke out in Madrid following a tragic train accident that resulted in 68 fatalities. Demonstrators, including far-right groups, clashed with riot police while demanding the resignation of the transport minister. The public is expressing significant anger over how the government has managed the aftermath of this deadly disaster.
amharic: በስፔን የባቡር አደጋ 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ማጣታቸውን ተከትሎ ማድሪድ ውስጥ ተቃውሞ ተቀስቅሷል። ተቃዋሚዎች የመንግስትን የአደጋ አያያዝ በመቃወም እና የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። በከተማዋ በተደረገው በዚህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ወቅት የፀጥታ ሃይሎች በቦታው ተገኝተው ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ሞክረዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti balaa baaburaa nama 68 galaafateen walqabatee magaalaa Maadriditti mormiin cimaan ka'eera. Hiriirtonni mootummaan balaa kana hordofee tarkaanfii fudhate irratti komii qabaachuun, ministirri geejjibaa aangoo gadhiisuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Mormiichi gara walitti bu'insa poolisii fi hiriirtotaa geessiseera.

title: Israelis rally for Jewish-Arab government after election gains
english: Following significant success in Israel's recent elections, demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv to advocate for a coalition government that includes both Jewish and Arab representatives. Arab political parties are expected to secure approximately 19 seats in the 120-member Knesset. This strong performance could grant these parties a meaningful role in shaping the nation's next governing administration.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ምርጫ የአረብ ተወካዮች ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ውጤት በማስመዝገባቸው፣ በአይሁድ እና በአረብ ጥምረት ላይ የተመሠረተ መንግሥት እንዲቋቋም የሚጠይቁ ሰልፈኞች በቴል አቪቭ ተሰባሰቡ። እነዚህ ፓርቲዎች በ120 መቀመጫ ባለው የፓርላማ ምክር ቤት (ክነስቲ) ወደ 19 የሚጠጉ መቀመጫዎችን እንደሚያሸንፉ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ውጤት የአረብ ፓርቲዎች ቀጣዩን መንግሥት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ሂደት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዲፈጥሩ እድል ሊሰጣቸው ይችላል።
oromo: Filannoo Israa'el darbe keessatti milkaa'ina guddaa booda, hiriirtonni magaalaa Tel Aviviitti walga'uun mootummaan ummata Yihuudii fi Arabaa walitti fidu akka hundaa'u gaafataniiru. Paartiileen Arabaa bakka bu'oota 120 qabu keessaa iddoo 19 ol akka argatan kan eegamu yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaa itti aanu hundeesuuf carraa guddaa isaaniif kenna. Milkaa'inni kun paartiileen kunneen murtee biyyaattii irratti gahee akka qabaatan gochuu danda'a.

title: No clear winner in Israel election with nearly 90 percent of votes counted
english: Israel's recent general election has resulted in a stalemate as neither major political bloc has secured the 61 seats required to form a government. With most votes counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing coalition remains the largest group but still lacks an outright majority. Caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu will remain in his position while party leaders begin the complex process of negotiating a potential coalition or unity government.
amharic: የእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ አንዳቸውም የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን 61 መቀመጫ ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው አጣብቂኝ ውስጥ ገብቷል። አብዛኛው ድምጽ ከተቆጠረ በኋላ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረት ትልቁ ቡድን ሆኖ ቢቀጥልም አሁንም አብላጫ ድምጽ አላገኘም። ኔታንያሁ አዲስ መንግስት እስኪቋቋም ድረስ በጊዜያዊነት ስልጣን ላይ የሚቆዩ ሲሆን የፖለቲካ መሪዎችም ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት ድርድር ይጀምራሉ።
oromo: Filannoon biyyoolessaa Israa'el gareewwan siyaasaa keessaa tokkollee mootummaa hundeessuuf kan isa barbaachisu teessoo 61 argachuu waan dadhabaniif wal-qixa ta'ee jira. Sagaleen baay'een erga lakka'amee booda, gareen Binyaamin Neetaanyaahu qaban hunda caalaa yoo ta'eefis, garuu guutuu ta'e hin arganne. Neetaanyaahu mootummaan haaraan hanga hundeeffamutti aangoo irratti kan turan yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni paartiiwwanii mootummaa waltainsaa hundeessuuf marii eegalu.

title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
english: A tragic high-speed train collision in central Spain has resulted in the deaths of at least 68 people and left many others injured. The accident occurred when a state-operated Renfe train struck a stationary Iryo train after a computer malfunction and a subsequent oversight by control room staff. Survivors described the scene as chaotic and terrifying, noting that the impact caused carriages to derail and created dangerous conditions for those on board.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ስፔን በደረሰ የከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ባቡር ግጭት ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የደረሰው የኮምፒውተር ችግር እና የቁጥጥር ማዕከል ሰራተኞች የፈጠሩት ስህተት ተከትሎ አንድ ተንቀሳቃሽ ባቡር መንገድ ላይ ቆሞ ከነበረ ሌላ ባቡር ጋር በመጋጨቱ ነው። በአደጋው የተረፉ ሰዎች ሁኔታው እጅግ አስፈሪና ግራ የሚያጋባ እንደነበር በመግለጽ፣ የባቡር ክፍሎቹ ከመንገዳቸው ወጥተው በመገለባበጣቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት መድረሱን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ispeen giddugaleessaatti balaan baabura saffisa olaanaa mudateen namoonni 68 ol du'anii, hedduun isaanii immoo madaa'aniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate, dogoggora sirna kompiitaraa fi ajaja dogoggoraa giddugala to'annoo irraa kennameen baaburri tokko baabura iddoo tokkotti dhaabbatee ture irratti bu'uun isaa ti. Namoonni balaa kanaan oolanii fi miidhaan irra ga'e akka ibsanitti, haalli sun baay'ee kan nama sodaachisuu fi baaburichi karaa irraa ka'ee waan kufuuf namoota hedduu irratti miidhaa cimaa geessiseera.

title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
english: A serious train collision occurred in Spain when a high-speed Renfe train struck an Iryo train after being mistakenly cleared to move. The two trains had been halted due to a computer-related signal failure on the route between Madrid and Seville. Passengers described scenes of confusion and chaos as the impact damaged carriages, though authorities are investigating how the error occurred.
amharic: ስፔን ውስጥ በመዲና ማድሪድ እና ሴቪል መካከል በነበሩ ሁለት ፈጣን ባቡሮች ግጭት ተከስቷል። ባቡሮቹ በምልክት መስጫ ኮምፒውተር ችግር ምክንያት ቆመው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የሬንፌ ባቡር በስህተት እንዲንቀሳቀስ በመታዘዙ ከፊቱ የነበረውን ሌላ ባቡር ግጭቷል። በደረሰው አደጋ ተሳፋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናት ስህተቱ እንዴት ሊከሰት እንደቻለ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti osoo hin taane, biyya Ispeen keessatti baaburonnii saffisaa lama walitti bu'uun balaa guddaan mudateera. Baaburonni kunneen rakkoo sirna mallattoo kompiitaraa irraa kan ka'e daandii irratti dhaabbatanii turan, haa ta'u malee, baaburri 'Renfe' jedhamu dogoggoraan akka deemu ajajamuun isaa baabura isa dura ture rukutuuf sababa ta'eera. Balaa kanaan imaltoonni hedduun rifannoo fi miidhaa keessa kan galan yoo ta'u, mootummaan immoo dogoggorichi akkamitti akka uumame qorachaa jira.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
english: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has arrived in Miami, denying claims that he is escaping Brazil to avoid legal issues. He maintains that his departure is a strategic move to protect his family and lead his supporters, despite facing criticism from President Lula da Silva. While he continues to challenge the legitimacy of the recent election, he expresses gratitude for the U.S. government's assistance in allowing his family to enter the country.
amharic: ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ወደ ማያሚ መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ ከብራዚል የሸሹት ህግን ለመሸሽ አይደለም ሲሉ አስተባበሉ። ምንም እንኳን በፕሬዝዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ቢተቹም፣ ጉዞው ቤተሰባቸውን ለመጠበቅ እና ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ለመምራት የታቀደ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ። ምርጫውን በተመለከተ ክሱን መቀጠላቸውን የገለጹት ቦልሶናሮ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ቤተሰባቸው ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዲገቡ ላደረገላቸው ድጋፍ ምስጋና አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gara Maayami kan gale yoo ta'u, biyyasaatii kan baqate rakkoo seeraa irraa ooluuf miti jechuun shakkii jiru haaleera. Inni akka jedhutti, imalli isaa maatii isaa eeguufi deggertoota isaa dursuuf kan godhame malee, balaa tokko baqachuuf akka hin taane ibseera. Prezidaant Luulaa da Silvaa irratti mormii kan qaban ta'us, qabxiilee filannoo darbee irratti komii kaasuunsaafi mootummaan Ameerikaa maatii isaa akka simatu hayyamuusaatti galata dhiyeesseera.

title: UN experts sound alarm at excessive use of force in French student protests
english: United Nations experts have criticized the French government for using excessive force against students protesting nationwide over poor school conditions and the high cost of living. The experts expressed concern that the mass arrests of minors and heavy-handed security tactics are discouraging young people from exercising their rights to peaceful assembly. While acknowledging recent attempts at dialogue, they warned that prioritizing security over addressing the underlying social issues is failing to resolve the unrest.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባለሙያዎች በፈረንሳይ ተማሪዎች ላይ እየተወሰደ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የኃይል እርምጃ ኮንነዋል። ባለሙያዎቹ በተለይም ታዳጊ ህጻናትን በብዛት ማሰር እና የጸጥታ ሃይሎችን ከመጠን በላይ መጠቀም ተማሪዎች ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ የማድረግ መብታቸውን እየገደበ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። መንግስት ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለጸጥታ ጉዳይ ቅድሚያ መስጠቱ የተማሪዎችን ቅሬታ እንደማይፈታ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ogeeyyoonni gamtaa mootummootaa, Faransaayitti barattoonni haala manneen barnootaa fi gatii jireenyaa dabaluun walqabatee hiriira bahani irratti humnaan tarkaanfii fudhatamu balaaleffataniiru. Hawaasi kun dargaggoota irratti hidhaan hedduun gaggeeffamuun fi humna mootummaan fayyadamu mirga hiriira nagaa bahuu akka ukkaamsu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo bu'uuraa furuu mannaa humnaan tasgabbeessuuf carraaquunsaa rakkoo biyyattii furuu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Costa Rica’s mega-prison receives first inmates
english: Costa Rica has officially opened a large-scale maximum-security prison near San Jose to combat rising violence linked to organized crime. The facility, which cost $35 million and was built with assistance from El Salvador, can hold over 5,000 inmates. This move reflects the government's stricter approach to crime and aims to decrease overcrowding in the country's existing correctional system.
amharic: ኮስታሪካ ከተደራጀ ወንጀል ጋር የተያያዘውን የኃይል ጥቃት ለመከላከል በሳን ሆሴ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ ጥበቃ የሚደረግለት ትልቅ እስር ቤት ከፍታለች። በ35 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ እና በኤል ሳልቫዶር እገዛ የተገነባው ይህ ማዕከል ከ5,000 በላይ እስረኞችን የመያዝ አቅም አለው። ይህ እርምጃ የመንግስትን ጥብቅ የወንጀል መከላከል ፖሊሲ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን በአገሪቱ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚታየውን መጨናነቅ ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Kosta Rikaan yakka gurmaa'e irraa maddu ittisuuf jecha, magaalaa San Jose biratti mana hidhaa guddaa fi eegumsa cimaa qabu banatteetti. Mana hidhaa kana ijaaruuf doolaara miliyoona 35 kan baase yoo ta'u, deeggarsa El Salvadoritiin ijaaramee namoota 5,000 ol qabachuu danda'a. Tarkaanfiin kun qajeelfama mootummaan yakka irratti fudhate kan calaqqisiisu fi mana hidhaa biyyattii keessatti guutummaa jiru salphisuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Indonesian students demand action on wildfires and rising costs
english: Hundreds of Indonesian students and activists recently gathered in Jakarta and other cities to demonstrate against President Prabowo Subianto. The protesters are calling for urgent government action to address forest fires that are damaging the environment. Additionally, they expressed frustration over current government spending habits and the rising cost of living.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ የሚገኙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎችና የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ አባላት በፕሬዚዳንት ፕራቦዎ ሱቢያንቶ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ተቃውሞአቸውን ገልጸዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግሥት እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የደን ቃጠሎ ለመቆጣጠር በቂ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ነው። በተጨማሪም፣ የመንግሥትን የበጀት አጠቃቀም በመተቸት፣ የኑሮ ውድነትን ለመቋቋም ፈጣን መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni fi miseensonni hawaasaa dhibbaan lakkaa'aman biyya Indoneezhiyaatti, mormii pirezidaantii biyyattii Piraaboowoo Suubiyaantoo irratti dhageessisaniiru. Namoonni kunneen gubachuu bosonaa fi rakkoolee naannoo mudate dhaabsisuuf mootummaan hatattamaan tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, adeemsa baasii mootummaa fi gatiin jireenyaa olka'uun isaa akka isaan yaaddessu ibsaniiru.

title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
english: Following his defeat in the Brazilian presidential election, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has traveled to Miami with his family. His departure occurred despite a court order requiring him to surrender his passports due to an ongoing investigation into money laundering. While his exit has sparked public criticism at home, the United States government has granted him and his family permission to enter the country.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫን ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር ወደ ማያሚ ተጉዘዋል። የገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል ምርመራን ተከትሎ ፓስፖርታቸውን እንዲያስረክቡ በፍርድ ቤት ቢታዘዙም ሀገሪቱን ለቀው ወጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊታቸው በብራዚል ውስጥ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ቢቀሰቅስም የአሜሪካ መንግስት ግን ለእርሳቸውና ለቤተሰቦቻቸው የመግቢያ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro erga filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyya Braazilitti injifatamee booda maatii isaa wajjin gara magaalaa Maayamiitti imaleera. Shakkii yakka dhiqxee maallaqaa waliin walqabatee paaspoortii isaanii akka kennan ajajni mana murtii kennamee utuu jiruu, biyyattii gadhiisee baheera. Gochi kun biyya keessatti mormii uumus, mootummaan Ameerikaa garuu isaanii fi maatii isaaniif hayyama seenuu kenneera.

title: UN votes to condemn embargo of Cuba despite US lobbying push
english: The United Nations General Assembly has passed a resolution calling for an end to the long-standing US economic embargo against Cuba. While the vote saw overwhelming support for the resolution, the US government noted a rise in abstentions as evidence that its diplomatic pressure is weakening international opposition. Cuban officials strongly criticized the American restrictions, describing them as harmful to their people and illegitimate.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ አሜሪካ በኩባ ላይ ለረጅም ዓመታት የጣለችውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንዲያነሳ የሚጠይቅ ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኞቹ አገራት ውሳኔውን ቢደግፉትም፣ አሜሪካ ድምጸ-ተአቅቦ ያደረጉ አገራት ቁጥር መጨመሩ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቷ ውጤታማ እየሆነ መምጣቱን ያሳያል ብላለች። የኩባ ባለስልጣናት ግን የአሜሪካን ማዕቀብ በመቃወም በሕዝባቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Waltajjii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti biyyoonni hedduu sagalee isaanii kennuun, Ameerikaan diinagdee Kuubaa irratti waggoota dheeraaf uumtee jirtu akka kaastu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoonni baay'een sagalee kennuu irraa of qusachuun isaanii, dhiibbaan isaan godhan milkaa'aa jiraachuu akka ibsu dubbateera. Haa ta'u malee, hoogganoonni Kuubaa qoodinsi diinagdee kun uummata isaanii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiru jechuun tarkaanfichatti mormii guddaa qabu.

title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
english: Partial election results in Israel indicate that former Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently leading, though his bloc has not yet secured an outright parliamentary majority. With a significant portion of votes still being processed, including those from soldiers and diplomats, the final outcome remains uncertain. President Isaac Herzog plans to consult with political leaders once the final count is confirmed to determine who will lead the effort to form a new government.
amharic: በእስራኤል የተካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ውጤት እንደሚያሳየው የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እየመሩ ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ገና ያልተቆጠሩ የውትድርና እና የዲፕሎማቶች ድምጾች በመኖራቸው የውጤቱ የመጨረሻ መልክ ገና አልታወቀም። የመጨረሻ ውጤቱ ከተረጋገጠ በኋላ፣ ፕሬዚዳንት አይዛክ ሄርዞግ ከፖለቲካ መሪዎች ጋር በመወያየት አዲስ መንግስት የመመስረት ስራ የሚረከበውን ሰው ይመርጣሉ።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo Israa'el jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, muummichi ministeeraa duraanii Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu hoggansa irra kan jiran ta'us, mootummaa hundeessuuf gahaa kan ta'e teessoo baay'inaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Sagaleen loltootaa fi diippiloomaatotaa hamma ammaa waan hin lakkaa'amneef, bu'aan xumuraa ammayyuu hin murtaa'in jira. Bu'aan xumuraa erga mirkanaa'ee booda, pirezidaanti Isaak Herzoog hoggantoota siyaasaa waliin mari'achuun eenyu akka mootummaa haaraa hundeessu akka murteessan eegama.

title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
english: Israel is facing a political stalemate as neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor challenger Gadi Eisenkot appears to have secured a parliamentary majority. To form a government, opposing parties may need to abandon campaign pledges, or the country could face the possibility of yet another round of elections. Potential solutions range from forming a unity government to navigating regional tensions, though current political divisions make reaching a stable agreement difficult.
amharic: እስራኤል በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና በተቀናቃኛቸው ጋዲ አይዘንኮት መካከል በፈጠረው የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምፅ እጥረት የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። መንግስት ለመመስረት ፓርቲዎች ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን ቃል ማጠፍ ሊኖርባቸው ይችላል፤ ይህ ካልሆነ ደግሞ ሀገሪቱ ወደ ሌላ ዙር ምርጫ የማምራት እድል አላት። የብሄራዊ አንድነት መንግስት መመስረት ወይም በክልሉ ውስጥ ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ ውጥረቶች የፖለቲካ መፍትሄ ሊሆኑ ቢችሉም፣ አሁን ያለው ከፍተኛ ልዩነት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Israa'el mootummaa hundeessuuf sagalee gahaa argachuuf kan rakkateefi waliin dhahuu siyaasaa keessa galtee jirti. Paartiileen mormituu tokko ta'uun mootummaa hundeessuuf waadaa galan cabsuu danda'u, yookaan ammoo biyyattiin gara filannoo biraatti ce'uu dandeessi. Mootummaa tokkummaa hundeessuu yookaan rakkoolee naannichaa keessatti mudatan furuun furmaata ta'uu danda'us, garaagarummaan siyaasaa amma jiru mootummaa tasgabbaa'aa ta'e ijaaruu hamma tokko rakkisaa godheera.

title: Putin: Russia is African continent’s best partner, not ‘colonial’ West
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin is hosting a two-day summit in Moscow with leaders from across Africa. During the event, he positioned Russia as a superior ally compared to Western nations. He criticized the West by labeling them as colonial powers that continue to exploit African resources for their own gain.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን በሞስኮ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት መሪዎችን ያሳተፈ የሁለት ቀን ጉባኤ እያካሄዱ ነው። በጉባኤው ላይ ሩሲያ ከአፍሪካ ሀገራት ጋር ያላት ግንኙነት ከምዕራባውያን የተሻለ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ምዕራባውያን የአፍሪካን የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ለራሳቸው ጥቅም የሚዘርፉ የቅኝ ግዛት አስተሳሰብ ያላቸው ሀገራት ናቸው ሲሉ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin gamtaan biyyoota Afrikaa waliin ta'uun magaalaa Moskootti guyyaa lamaaf walga'ii gaggeessaa jiru. Walga'ii kanaan, Raashiyaan hiriyyaa Afrikaaf caalu ta'uu ishee ibsuun, biyyoota Dhihaaf qeeqa dhiyeessaniiru. Biyyoota Dhihaa kanneen akka alagaa (koloneeffataa) biyyoota Afrikaa saamuun qabeenya isaanii qofaatti fayyadamaa jiran jechuun himataniiru.

title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged despite inflation in the US
english: The US Federal Reserve has decided to keep interest rates steady between 3.75 and 4 percent, despite ongoing concerns over rising inflation. Officials stated that economic activity remains strong and are choosing a cautious approach while they monitor future economic data. This decision comes shortly before the US midterm elections and follows a period of significant price increases, particularly in the energy sector.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ ባንክ የዋጋ ግሽበት እየጨመረ ቢሆንም የወለድ ምጣኔን ከ3.75 እስከ 4 በመቶ እንደያዘ ለማቆየት ወስኗል። የባንኩ አመራሮች የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ አሁንም ጠንካራ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን ለመገምገም ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አካሄድ መርጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከሀገሪቱ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ጥቂት ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ የወጣ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በኃይል ዘርፍ የታየውን የዋጋ ጭማሪ ተከትሎ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Federaalaalawaa (US Federal Reserve) gatiin jireenyaa fi gabaa keessatti gatiin meeshaalee dabaluu isaatiin kan wal qabate, dhala baankii dhibbeentaa 3.75 hanga 4 irratti akka inni hin jijjiiramne murteesseera. Hoggantoonni baankichaa diinagdeen biyyattii amma ammata cimuu isaa fi gabaa irratti jijjiiramoota dhufan hordofuuf jecha of eeggannoon tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka barbaadan ibsaniiru. Murteen kun filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa Ameerikaa dura kan darbe yoo ta'u, baasiin humna ibsaa fi boba'aa dabaluu isaatiin kan wal qabatee kan dhufedha.

title: What are the implications of Israel’s elections?
english: Israel's recent election resulted in no clear winner, leaving both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing coalition and the main opposition bloc without a majority to form a government. Voter turnout reached record levels during this highly consequential vote, held amidst ongoing military conflicts. A notable outcome is the unprecedented electoral success of parties representing Palestinian citizens, though forming a stable government remains difficult due to deep political divisions.
amharic: በእስራኤል በተካሄደው ምርጫ አሸናፊ የሆነ ወገን ባለመኖሩ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረትም ሆነ የተቃዋሚው ቡድን መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ባለበት ሁኔታ በተከናወነው በዚህ ወሳኝ ምርጫ ከፍተኛ የመራጮች ተሳትፎ ታይቷል። በአንጻሩ የእስራኤል የፍልስጤም ተወላጆችን የሚወክሉ ፓርቲዎች ታሪክ ባልተለመደ መልኩ ድጋፍ ማግኘታቸው ቢታወቅም፣ በፖለቲካው ክፍፍል ምክንያት የተረጋጋ መንግስት ለመመስረት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Filannoon Israa'el kaleessa gaggeeffame injifannoo ifa ta'e tokko malee waan xumurameef, gamtaan Muummee Ministiraa Binyamin Netiyaahuus ta'e mormitoonni mootummaa dhaabuuf sagalee gahaa hin arganne. Filannoon kun waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti waan ta'eef, namoonni baay'een sagaleechuuf bahan. Paartiileen lammiilee Falasxiin kan Israa'el bakka bu'an guddina ajaa'ibaa yoo galmeessisan iyyuu, rakkoo siyaasaa fi wal-dhabdee jiruun mootummaan tasgabbaa'e tokko dhaabuun ammayyuu ulfaataa ta'ee jira.

title: US jury convicts Rwandan American of lying about role in genocide
english: A federal jury in Boston found Rwandan American Eric Nshimiye guilty of perjury and obstruction of justice for lying about his participation in the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Prosecutors proved that Nshimiye falsely claimed he and a former classmate were not involved in violence against Tutsis during testimony in a previous 2019 trial. He also misled US immigration officials to obtain citizenship while hiding his history of participating in lethal attacks.
amharic: በቦስተን የሚገኝ የፌዴራል ዳኞች በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩት ሩዋንዳዊ ኤሪክ ንሺሚዬ በ1994ቱ የሩዋንዳ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ስለነበራቸው ተሳትፎ በመዋሸታቸው ጥፋተኛ መሆናቸውን ወስነዋል። ተከሳሹ ከዚህ ቀደም በ2019 በተደረገ የፍርድ ሂደት እሳቸውም ሆኑ አብረዋቸው የነበሩ ግለሰቦች በዘር ማጥፋቱ አልተሳተፉም ብለው የሰጡት ቃል ሀሰት መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል። በተጨማሪም፣ ንሺሚዬ የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ለማግኘት ሲሉ በወንጀሉ ውስጥ የነበራቸውን ተሳትፎ በመደበቅ ለኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ሀሰተኛ መረጃ ሰጥተው እንደነበር በምርመራ ታውቋል።
oromo: Mana murti federaala Bostonitti argamu tokko, lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Eric Nshimiye bara 1994 fixiinsa sanyii Ruwaandaa irratti hirmaachuu isaanii dhoksuudhaan dhugaa baatii sobaa kennuu fi seera gufachiisuun yakka irratti mirkaneesseera. Nshimiye bara 2019 namoota biroo irratti dhugaa ba'an yeroo sana ofii isaa fi hiriyoonni isaa fixiinsa sana keessatti harka hin qabne jedhanii sobuu isaanii qorattoonni mirkaneessaniiru. Namichi kun lamummaa Ameerikaa argachuuf jecha, seenaa isaa kana dhoksuun qaama dhimmi isaa ilaallatuuf odeeffannoo sobaa kennuun yakka hojjetameera.

title: Putin tells African leaders Moscow will not pursue ‘neo-colonialism’
english: During the third Russia-Africa Summit, President Vladimir Putin claimed that Russia acts as a fair partner for Africa, distancing Moscow from the practices of former colonial nations. He accused Western countries of using debt and predatory financial tactics to exploit African resources and hinder the continent's development. In contrast, Putin emphasized that Russia focuses on local processing and expanding agricultural trade to support the growth and stability of African nations.
amharic: በሶስተኛው የሩሲያ-አፍሪካ ጉባኤ ላይ ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ሩሲያ ከአፍሪካ ጋር የምትሰራው እንደ ቀድሞ ቅኝ ገዢዎች ሳይሆን በእኩልነት ላይ የተመሰረተ አጋርነት ነው ብለዋል። ምዕራባውያን አገራት በዕዳ ወጥመድ እና በማታለል የአፍሪካን ሀብት እንደሚዘርፉ የገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ሩሲያ ግን የአፍሪካን ኢኮኖሚ ለማሳደግ እና የሥራ ዕድል ለመፍጠር ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ሩሲያ ለምግብ ዋስትና የሚውል የእህል እና የግብርና ምርቶች አቅርቦትን ለአፍሪካ ሀገራት ለማሳደግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Gubaa sadaffaa biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Afrikaa irratti, pirezidaant Vladimir Putin akka jedhanitti Raashiyaan Afrikaa wajjin kan hojjettu akka biyyoota koloneeffattoota durii otoo hin taane, gargaarsa walqixummaa irratti hundaa'een dha. Biyyoonni dhihaa Afrikaa qabeenya ishee saamuuf jecha biyyattii gargaarsa liqii fi mala qirixummaan fayyadamuun qabeenya ishee akka hatan ceepha'aniiru. Raashiyaan garuu jijjiirama dinagdee fi uumuu carraa hojiif Afrikaa wajjin hojjechuuf kan qophoofte ta'uu fi, dhiyeessa midhaan nyaataa dabaluufis waadaa seenaniiru.

title: Democrats party leader says Arab party could be part of government coalition
english: Yair Golan, the head of the Democrats party, recently stated that he is open to including the Arab-led Ra’am party in a future Israeli government coalition. He argued that such an alliance is possible, noting that Prime Minister Netanyahu had also considered similar partnerships in the past. Golan emphasized the need for opposition groups to unite and form a new administration to replace the current leadership.
amharic: የዲሞክራቶች ፓርቲ መሪ ያኢር ጎላን በአረቦች የሚመራው የራዕም ፓርቲ ወደፊት በሚመሰረተው የእስራኤል መንግስት ጥምረት ውስጥ ሊካተት እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ቀደም ባሉት ጊዜያት ተመሳሳይ የትብብር አማራጮችን እንደተመለከቱ በማስታወስ፣ የራዕም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስን በስልጣን ጥምረት ውስጥ ማካተት ምንም ችግር እንደሌለው ተናግረዋል። ጎላን አክለውም፣ አሁን ባለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ የተቃዋሚው ቡድን አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በጋራ መስራት እንዳለበት አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Diimokiraatotaa Ya’iir Golaan, paartiin Ra’am jedhamu kan Arabaan durfamu mootummaa Israa’el gara fuulduraatti dhaabbatu keessatti hirmaachuu akka danda’u ibsaniiru. Golaan, Muummeen Ministiraa Benyaamiin Neetaanyaahuun kanaan dura waliigaltee akkasii yaaluu isaanii eeruun, hogganaan paartii Ra’am Maansuur Abbaas mootummaa keessa galuun isaa rakkoo akka hin qabne dubbataniiru. Kana malees, gareen mormituu amma jiru mootummaa haaraa dhaabuuf tokko ta’uu akka qabu dhaamaniiru.

title: Seven Israeli attacks against West Bank farmers in 12 hours reported
english: Israeli forces and settlers carried out seven separate attacks against Palestinian farmers across the West Bank within a single 12-hour period on Wednesday. The incidents involved the destruction of crops, property, and agricultural infrastructure, as well as the detention of farmers and the restriction of their land access. In response, officials have urged the international community to intervene to stop these violations and protect the livelihoods of the local farming population.

title: Experts defer to AI in decision-making, Anthropic study finds
english: A recent study by Anthropic reveals that professional analysts are highly likely to rely on AI recommendations, often mirroring the suggestions of their digital assistants 86 percent of the time. Even when experts held an initial opinion, they frequently abandoned it when the AI expressed a conflicting view. Despite this strong influence, the majority of participants failed to acknowledge the AI as the source of their reasoning when justifying their final choices.
amharic: በአንትሮፒክ የተደረገ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ባለሙያዎች ውሳኔ በሚሰጡበት ጊዜ በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) ምክሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥገኛ የመሆን ዝንባሌ አላቸው። ጥናቱ እንደጠቆመው ባለሙያዎች በ86 በመቶ የሚሆኑ አጋጣሚዎች ከ AI ምክር ጋር የሚስማማ ውሳኔ ይወስዳሉ፣ አንዳንዴም ቀድመው የያዙትን አመለካከት በአይ (AI) ምክንያት ይለውጣሉ። ሆኖም ብዙዎቹ ባለሙያዎች ውሳኔያቸውን ሲያብራሩ ይህ ተጽዕኖ እንደደረሰባቸው ሳይገልጹ ቀርተዋል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhaabbata Anthropic gaggeesse akka ibsutti, ogeeyyonni hojii isaanii keessatti gorsa tekinoolojii AI irratti harka caaluun kan hirkatan ta’uu mirkaneesseera. Qorannicharratti hirmaattonni gorsa AI dhiyeesse hordofuun dhibbeentaa 86 irratti murtee isaanii walsimsiisuun kan mul'ate yoo ta'u, yaada dura qabanis yoo AI irratti waliigaluu baate kan jijjiirran ta'uu argisiiseera. Ta'us, ogeeyyonni kunneen murtee isaanii yeroo ibsan, gorsa AI fayyadamuu isaanii ifatti baasuuf fedhii kan hin qabne ta'uun hubatameera.

title: ‘Working our fingers to the bone’: Can the UK save its struggling high streets?
english: Small business owners in the UK are struggling to stay open as rising operational costs like rent, energy, and taxes put immense pressure on their profits. Many shop owners are finding it impossible to compete with the growth of online retail, leading them to consider closing or moving their businesses. While the government may introduce tax relief in the upcoming budget, many entrepreneurs argue it will not be enough to solve their deep-seated financial hardships.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ አነስተኛ የንግድ ተቋማት ባለቤቶች የኪራይ፣ የሃይል አቅርቦት እና የታክስ ጭማሪ በአትራፊነታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና በመፍጠሩ የንግድ ስራቸውን ለማስቀጠል እየተቸገሩ ነው። ብዙዎቹ ነጋዴዎች ከኦንላይን ንግድ ጋር ለመወዳደር እየከበዳቸው በመሆኑ ንግዳቸውን ለመዝጋት ወይም ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ለመዛወር እየተገደዱ ነው። መንግስት በመጪው በጀት አመት የታክስ እፎይታ ሊሰጥ ቢችልም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ የንግድ ባለቤቶች ይህ መፍትሄ ያላቸውን የገንዘብ ችግር ለመቅረፍ በቂ እንደማይሆን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Abbootiin qabeenyaa gurguddoo hin taane kan UK keessa jiran, gatiin kiraa, ibsaa fi gibirri dabaluun bu'aa isaanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa waan uumeef hojii isaanii itti fufsiisuuf rakkachaa jiru. Namoonni baay'een suuqii qaban, gurgurtaa intarneetii waliin dorgomuun waan itti ulfaateef, suuqii isaanii cufu ykn gara iddoo biraatti jijjiirrachuu yaadaa jiru. Mootummaan baajata dhufu keessatti furmaata gibiraa kennuuf kan karoorfatu ta'us, abbootiin qabeenyaa hedduun gargaarsi kun rakkoo isaanii furuuf ga'aa akka hin taane dubbatu.

title: Netanyahu outlines achievements, future plans as Likud leads Israeli polls
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is leading in recent elections, with his Likud party projected to become the largest in parliament. While his bloc holds a significant lead, he still lacks a clear majority to form a government and will likely need to negotiate a coalition. Netanyahu emphasized his record of neutralizing regional adversaries and stated that a right-wing coalition is essential for Israel's future security.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ የሊኩድ ፓርቲያቸው በአብላጫ ድምፅ በመምራት ላይ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፓርቲያቸው ቀዳሚ ቢሆንም መንግሥት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል በቂ መቀመጫ ስላልያዙ፣ ሌላ የቅንጅት መንግሥት ለመመስረት ድርድር ሊያስፈልጋቸው እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል። ኔታንያሁ በሥልጣን ላይ በነበሩበት ጊዜ የወሰዷቸውን የፀጥታ እርምጃዎች ያወደሱ ሲሆን፣ ለወደፊትም ጠንካራ የቀኝ አክራሪ መንግሥት መመስረት ለእስራኤል ደህንነት አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu filannoo biyyattii irratti paartiin isaanii Likud baay'ina sagaleetiin dursaa jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Paartiin isaanii filannoo kana injifachaa kan jiru ta'us, mootummaa dhaabuuf sagalee gahaa waan hin arganneef, paartilee biroo waliin walta'iinsa uumuu akka qaban tilmaamameera. Neetaanyaahuun yeroo aangoo isaanii keessatti tarkaanfiiwwan nageenyaa fudhataman kan galateeffatan yoo ta'u, nageenya Israa'el gara fuulduraa mirkaneessuuf mootummaa gara mirgaatti kan amanu uumuu akka barbaadan dubbataniiru.

title: Netanyahu says his bloc will win 'decisive majority'
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has expressed confidence that his Likud party will secure a major electoral victory. He declared that his party remains the most powerful force in the country with no real competition. Furthermore, he emphasized that his right-wing political coalition has achieved a clear and decisive majority in the government.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሊኩድ ፓርቲያቸው ታላቅ የምርጫ ድል እንደሚቀዳጅ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። ፓርቲያቸው በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ ምንም ተወዳዳሪ የሌለው ጠንካራ ኃይል መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የቀኝ ዘመም የፖለቲካ ጥምረታቸው በመንግስት ውስጥ ግልጽ እና ወሳኝ አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘታቸውን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuun paartiin isaa Liikud injifannoo guddaa akka argatu abdii qabaachuu isaa ibseera. Paartiin isaa biyyattii keessatti humna cimaa fi morkataa hin qabne ta'uu isaa dubbateera. Kana malees, gamtaan siyaasaa mirgaa inni durfamu mootummaa keessatti sagalee caalmaa ifaa fi murteessaa ta'e argachuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Netanyahu's bloc leads at 55 seats, but short of majority vote
english: Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition is currently leading in the Israeli elections with 55 seats, though it has fallen short of the majority needed to govern. Gadi Eisenkot’s group follows with 49 seats, while Arab parties hold 16. These results are preliminary, as only about half of the total votes have been counted so far.
amharic: የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ጥምረት በ55 መቀመጫዎች ቀዳሚ ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን አብላጫ ድምፅ አላገኘም። የጋዲ አይዘንኮት ቡድን በ49 መቀመጫዎች በመከተል ላይ ሲሆን፣ የአረብ ፓርቲዎች ደግሞ 16 መቀመጫዎችን ይዘዋል። እነዚህ ውጤቶች ገና ያልተጠናቀቁ ሲሆን እስካሁን የተቆጠረው ከግማሽ በታች የሚሆነው ድምፅ ብቻ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Biniyaamii Neetan yaahuu bakka bu'oota 55n dursaa jiraatus, caalmaa sagalee mootummaa hundeessuuf barbaachisu argachuu hin dandeenye. Gareen Gaadii Aayizankootti bakka bu'oota 49n itti aansuun, paartiileen Arabaa immoo bakka bu'oota 16 qabatu. Bu'aan kun ammayyuu kan hin xumuramin yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti sagaleewwan kennaman keessaa walakkaan isaanii qofa kan lakkaa'aman.

title: Ra’am leader accuses Netanyahu of ‘lying and inciting’ against Arab party
english: Mansour Abbas, the leader of the Ra'am party, has rejected claims made by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding election fraud. Netanyahu had alleged that members of the Arab party were attempting to manipulate the vote, but election officials found no proof to support these accusations. Abbas argues that these claims are intended to provoke voters and manipulate public opinion to benefit Netanyahu's political goals.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ያቀረቡትን የምርጫ ማጭበርበር ክስ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ኔታንያሁ የፓርቲው አባላት ድምፅ ለመስረቅ እንደሞከሩ ቢከሱም፣ የምርጫ ባለስልጣናት ይህን የሚያረጋግጥ ማስረጃ አላገኙም። አባስ እንደሚሉት ከሆነ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች የተጠቀሙት የራሳቸውን ደጋፊዎች ለማነሳሳት እና በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ጥላቻን ለመፍጠር ነው።
oromo: Manni maree paartii Ra’am, Mansour Abbas, himata sobaa kan pirezidaantii Israa’el Biniyamin Netanyaahuu paartii isaarratti dhiyeessan mormaniiru. Netanyaahuun miseensonni paartii Arabaa filannoo hatuuf yaalaniiru jechuun himatanis, abbootiin taayitaa filannoo himata kanaaf ragaa kamiyyuu dhabaniiru. Abbas akka jedhanitti, himanni kun kan dhiyaate deggertoota Netanyaahuu kakaasuuf fi paartii isaarratti jibba uumuuf qofa dha.

title: More than 2.7 million votes counted, Palestinian-led parties overtake Bennett’s Together alliance at third place
english: Following the counting of over 2.7 million votes in Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc maintains a lead despite a minor drop in projected seats. Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar party currently sits in second place. Notably, Palestinian-led parties have moved into third, surpassing Naftali Bennett’s Together alliance.
amharic: በእስራኤል ከ2.7 ሚሊዮን በላይ ድምፆች ከተቆጠሩ በኋላ የቢንያም ኔታንያሁ ቡድን የመሪነቱን ቦታ ይዞ ቀጥሏል። የጋዲ አይዘንኮት የያሻር ፓርቲ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ሲሆን፣ የፍልስጤም መሪዎች የሚመሩት ጥምረት ደግሞ የናፍታሊ ቤኔትን የቱጌዘር ጥምረት በመቅደም በሶስተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ተቀምጠዋል።
oromo: Israa'el keessatti sagaleen miiliyoona 2.7 ol erga lakka'amee booda, gareen Binyaam Netaanyaahuu fooyyee qabaatus dursaa jira. Paartiin Gadii Ayizenkoo kan Yaashaar jedhamu sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti argama. Kana malees, paartiileen Filaasxeemotaan durfaman garee Naaftaalli Beeneet kan 'Together' jedhamu caaluudhaan sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti argamu.

title: Trump claims his backing of Netanyahu reversed his 'decisive defeat' in Israeli elections
english: Former President Donald Trump asserted that his political support for Benjamin Netanyahu significantly changed the outcome of Israel's elections. He claimed that his endorsement prevented a major loss for the Prime Minister and instead shifted the results toward a potential victory or a tie. Trump emphasized that his intervention was intended to benefit the stability of both Israel and the United States.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለቢንያም ኔታንያሁ የሰጡት ድጋፍ የእስራኤልን የምርጫ ውጤት በአዎንታዊ መልኩ እንደቀየረው ተናግረዋል። ትራምፕ እንደሚሉት፣ ድጋፋቸው ለኔታንያሁ ሊደርስባቸው የነበረውን ከባድ ሽንፈት አስቀርቶ ወደ ድል ወይም አቻ ውጤት እንዲመጡ አድርጓቸዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ ለእስራኤል፣ ለአሜሪካ እና ለመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሰላም አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp deeggarsi isaanii Binyaam Netaaniyaahuuf kennan bu'aa filannoo Israa'eel jijjiiruuf gargaareera jedhaniiru. Traamp akka jedhanitti, deeggarsi isaanii kun injifannoo dhabuu Netaaniyaahuu hambisee, bu'aa filannichaa gara injifannootti ykn qixxaatti akka jijjiirame dubbataniiru. Deeggarsi kun Israa'eel, Ameerikaafi guutummaa biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaatiif gaariidha jedhaniiru.

title: Arab parties could win 18 Israeli parliament seats
english: Early exit polls from Israel's recent election indicate that Arab-led parties could secure a historic 18 seats in parliament. This result follows a record-breaking 80 percent voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel. As the main political blocs remain deadlocked, these parties are now in a crucial position to influence the formation of the next government.

title: Exit polls trigger heated debate across Israeli political divide
english: Israel's recent exit polls indicate a deadlocked election between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition and the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot, with neither side securing the 61 seats needed for a majority. While opposition leaders are framing the results as a significant rejection of the current government, Netanyahu's allies argue that it is too early to declare a outcome. The final government formation will likely depend on the 18 seats held by unaligned Arab parties, who are now positioned as key players in upcoming coalition talks.

oromo: Bu'aan ba'ii filannoo Israa'el kan agarsiisu gamtaan Muummee Ministiraa Benjamin Netanyahu fi mormitoonni Gadi Eisenkotin geggeeffaman wal qixxee ta'uu isaanii ti; lamaanuu teessoo 61 kan mootummaa hundeessuuf barbaachisu argachuu hin dandeenye. Hogganoonni mormituu bu'aa kana akka injifannoo guddaa fi mormii mootummaa ammaa irratti mul'ateetti yoo lakka'an, deggertonni Netanyahu garuu hanga bu'aan xumuraa ifa ta'utti mariin dura akka ta'e dubbatu. Hunda'iinsi mootummaa gara fuulduraa kan hundaa'u paartilee Arabootaatiin yoo ta'u, isaanis marii kootaaliishinii irratti murteessitoota ta'u.

title: ‘This is America’: US envoy scolds Cuban diplomat at UN
english: A tense confrontation occurred at the United Nations in New York between a US envoy and Cuban representatives. During a session regarding the ongoing US trade embargo and fuel blockade against Cuba, the American diplomat repeatedly confronted the Cuban team by stating 'This is America.' The clash highlighted the deepening diplomatic friction between the two nations.

title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
english: A ceasefire in the Kherson region of Ukraine has been expanded to allow humanitarian aid to reach trapped residents in the city of Oleshky. The truce, brokered with the help of Melania Trump, has stopped military hostilities and will facilitate food and medicine deliveries. Authorities plan to organize evacuations for remaining civilians by Friday, with the agreement set to last until November 1.

title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
english: A veteran zookeeper in the Netherlands has passed away after being attacked by two Persian leopards inside their enclosure. The long-time employee suffered critical injuries while caring for the animals during poor weather and later died in the hospital. The safari park is investigating the incident, though they have stated the leopards were acting on natural instincts and will not be put down.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil after election loss, US says will grant visa
english: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has reportedly left for the United States following his defeat in the presidential election. This departure occurs amid a Supreme Court investigation into money laundering allegations against him, which included a request for him to surrender his passport. The U.S. government has confirmed it will grant visas to the senator and his family, a move criticized by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

Mootummaan Ameerikaa senatorichaa fi maatii isaatiif viizaa akka kennu kan mirkaneesse yoo ta'u, gochi kun pirezidaant Lula da Silva biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Trump showcases Venezuelan oil as he seeks to rally voters in Texas
english: President Trump showcased a tanker in Texas that he claims is carrying one million barrels of Venezuelan oil as part of a victory following military intervention in that country. He is using this shipment to address voter concerns over high fuel costs caused by the ongoing war with Iran ahead of the midterm elections. While the President describes this as a major energy gain, experts remain skeptical about the short-term economic benefits of the deal.

title: Forever Wars: Why can’t America stop?
english: The United States remains entangled in ongoing Middle Eastern conflicts despite widespread public opposition. Experts are debating whether these persistent wars are driven by economic interests like the massive defense industry, lobbying efforts, or systemic political flaws. The discussion highlights the difficulty voters face in holding leaders accountable and ending these long-term military engagements.

title: Will players in the Gulf establish a new security framework?
english: High-ranking officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey, and Iran have gathered in Tehran for urgent talks aimed at reducing regional tensions. This meeting is seen as a critical opportunity to prevent further conflict amidst threats of potential military action between Iran, the United States, and Israel. The participants are exploring whether these regional powers can collaborate to establish a more stable security environment in the Gulf.

title: Dream postponed: Hebron groom caught in Israeli military lockdown
english: A Palestinian man named Haidar Yahya Tamimi was forced to postpone his wedding after Israeli military forces placed the city of Hebron under a strict lockdown. Following a fatal attack on soldiers, thousands of residents, including Haidar and his family, were ordered to evacuate their homes. The couple had spent months preparing for their marriage, but their celebration has been indefinitely delayed as they remain displaced.

oromo: dargaggeessi Filisxeemii Hayidar Yahyaa Taamimii jedhamu, waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Heebroon keessatti labsiin yeroo waraanaa waan labsameef cidha isaa dheeressuuf dirqameera. title: Joint List leader says voters sent clear message to ‘government of bloodshed’
english: Yousef Jabareen, a prominent figure in the Joint List, described the recent Israeli election as a historic moment for his political group. He stated that the high voter turnout clearly signals public opposition to the current leadership, which he labeled a government of bloodshed. Jabareen emphasized that his party is a vital political force whose influence is essential for any future governing efforts.

oromo: Hoggantoonni 'Joint List' kan ta'an Yuusef Jaabareen, filannoo Israa'el darbe dhaabbata isaaniitiif guyyaa seena qabeessa jedhaniiru. Dabalataanis, paartiin isaanii humna siyaasaa guddaa waan ta'eef, hirmaannaa isaaniin alatti gara fuulduraatti mootummaan uumamu akka hin danda'amne ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli far-right minister says Eisenkot-led government would ‘paralyse’ his party’s work
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has warned that a government led by Gadi Eisenkot would obstruct his party's policy goals. Ben-Gvir expressed satisfaction with his own party's performance, as they are expected to secure several seats in the new parliament. His remarks highlight growing political friction as the country navigates the formation of a new government following recent elections.

title: Israeli exit polls show huge Palestinian gains block Netanyahu from forming government
english: Recent exit polls in Israel indicate that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his opponents are both struggling to secure a majority in the Knesset. This political deadlock is largely due to a historic increase in voter turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel, whose representatives have gained significant parliamentary seats. Consequently, neither side currently possesses the sixty-one seats necessary to establish a new governing coalition.

title: Palestinian voter mobilisation a ‘truly historic development’, analyst says
english: A political analyst has labeled the high voter turnout among Palestinian citizens in Israel as a historic move against current government policies. These voters are seeking to challenge ongoing violence in Gaza and the West Bank while pushing for a departure from the country's current path. The outcome of this mobilization is viewed as a critical opportunity to move away from systemic discrimination and toward a more ethical future.

title: Veteran commentator says results mark ‘end of the Netanyahu era’
english: Political analyst Meron Rapoport claims the recent election results signal the conclusion of Benjamin Netanyahu’s time as prime minister. Although Netanyahu's Likud party remains the largest, he lacks enough parliamentary support to secure a governing majority. Political leaders may now prioritize forming a new coalition to prevent the uncertainty of holding additional elections.

title: Ballon d'Or ceremony raises case of French sports journalist jailed in Algeria
english: The Ballon d'Or ceremony in London drew global attention to the case of French sports journalist Christophe Gleizes, who is currently serving a seven-year prison sentence in Algeria. Arrested while reporting on a football club in the Kabylie region, Gleizes was accused of supporting terrorism due to his journalistic contacts. Presenters at the awards event advocated for his freedom, highlighting that his detention is widely considered an unjust crackdown on his professional work.

title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
english: Football star Kylian Mbappé has issued an apology after making an insensitive remark about the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong during a television interview. His comments triggered significant backlash in China, leading several brands to end their partnerships with him. Both Mbappé and Spain's La Liga have expressed regret, acknowledging that the joke caused deep offense to many people.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ኪሊያን ምባፔ በቻይና የቀድሞ መሪ ማኦ ዜዱንግ ላይ በሰጠው አግባብነት የለሽ አስተያየት ሳቢያ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ይህ ንግግሩ በቻይና ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን በማስነሳቱ ምክንያት በርካታ ኩባንያዎች ከእርሱ ጋር የነበራቸውን የንግድ ትብብር አቋርጠዋል። ምባፔም ሆነ የስፔን ላ ሊጋ፣ ይህ ቀልድ በብዙ ሰዎች ላይ ስሜታዊ ጉዳት ማድረሱን በመገንዘብ ጥልቅ መጸጸታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa Kiliyan Mbappe, waayee hogganaa Chaayinaa durii Mao Zedong irratti ibsa miira namoota hedduu tuqu erga kenne booda dhiifama gaafateera. Ibsi kun Chaayinaa keessatti mormii guddaa kaasuu isaatiin walqabatee, dhaabbileen gurguddoon hedduun waliigaltee isaanii isa waliin akka dhaaban godheera. Mbappeenis ta'e liiguun ispaaniyaa (La Liga), qoosni kun namoota hedduu akka miidhe hubachuun gaabbii guddaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Russia jails IT worker for 13 years for donating money to Ukraine
english: A Russian military court sentenced an IT specialist, Yuri Belenkiy, to 13 years in prison for donating cryptocurrency to support the Ukrainian military. The conviction relied on transaction records provided by the cryptocurrency exchange Binance to Russian authorities. Belenkiy, who maintains his innocence, plans to appeal the decision after being accused of funding a group labeled as a terrorist organization by Russia.
amharic: የሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት ለዩክሬን ጦር በዲጂታል ገንዘብ (ክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ) ድጋፍ አድርጓል በሚል ዩሪ ቤሌንኪ የተባሉ የቴክኖሎጂ ባለሙያ ላይ የ13 ዓመት እስራት ፈርዷል። የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ የተመሰረተው የክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ መገበያያ ድርጅት የሆነው ባይናንስ ለሩሲያ ምርመራ ቡድን ባቀረበው የመረጃ ልውውጥ ነው። ተከሳሹ ወንጀሉን በመካድ ይግባኝ እንደሚጠይቁ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በሩሲያ አሸባሪ ተብሎ በተፈረጀ ቡድን ላይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አድርገዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸው ነበር።
oromo: Mana murtii waraanaa Raashiyaa, Yuri Belenkiy kan jedhaman ogeessa teeknoolojii, torbee Ukraine gargaaruuf qarshii dijitaalaa (cryptocurrency) waan erganiif hidha waggaa 13 itti murteesse. Murtii kana irratti ragaan ijoo kan ta'e, gabaasa gurgurtaa qarshii dijitaalaa 'Binance' jedhamuun qorattoota Raashiyaaf dhiyaate dha. Belenkiy yakka kana haaluun ol-iyyannoo galfachuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, Raashiyaan garee inni gargaare jedhamu sun garee shororkeessaa dha jechuun himatteetti.

title: Rain brings temporary relief as Southeast Asia battles fires and toxic haze
english: Recent rainfall has provided a short break from the wildfires currently affecting Indonesia. Despite this, persistent underground peat fires are still active, causing dangerous levels of air pollution across Southeast Asia. The resulting toxic haze has forced schools to shut down and triggered widespread health issues among the local population.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ዝናብ በኢንዶኔዥያ እየተከሰተ ካለው የዱር እሳት ለጊዜው እፎይታ ሰጥቷል። ይሁን እንጂ ከመሬት በታች የሚነዱ የፔት እሳቶች አሁንም ስላሉ በደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ አካባቢ አደገኛ የአየር ብክለት እንዲፈጠር አድርገዋል። ይህ መርዛማ ጭስ ትምህርት ቤቶች እንዲዘጉ እና በህዝቡ ላይ የጤና ችግሮች እንዲከሰቱ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Roobni hamma tokko roobe kun, ibiddi bosonaa Indoneesiyaa keessatti ka’e hamma tokko akka tasgabbaa’u godheera. Haata’u malee, ibiddi lafa jala gubatu waan jiruuf, aaran summii ta’e kun guutummaa Eeshiyaa Kibba-Bahaa keessatti afuudhaan qilleensichi akka faalamu ta’eera. Aaran kun mana barnootaa akka cufamu fi namoota hedduu irratti rakkoo fayyaa akka uumu godheera.

title: The WhatsApp ‘general’ behind Lula’s election comeback in Brazil
english: Brazilian Congressman Andre Janones is credited with helping President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva secure his recent election victory by organizing a massive digital movement. Janones utilized a WhatsApp channel called 'Lula's Army' to mobilize supporters, growing the group to nearly 11 million subscribers during the final weeks of the campaign. By adopting aggressive social media tactics, he successfully countered the opposition's online influence and boosted morale for Lula's campaign when it was struggling.
amharic: የብራዚል የፓርላማ አባል አንድሬ ጃኖነስ ለፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የምርጫ ድል ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ አድርገዋል። ጃኖነስ 'የሉላ ጦር' የተሰኘ የዋትስአፕ ግሩፕ በመፍጠር በምርጫው የመጨረሻ ሳምንታት ወደ 11 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ተከታዮችን በማሰባሰብ የሉላን ዘመቻ አጠናክረዋል። ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን ለመግጠም በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተጠቀሙባቸው ስልቶች የሉላ ዘመቻ ፈታኝ በሆነበት ወቅት ድጋፋቸውን በማሳደግ ወሳኝ ሚና ተጫውተዋል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree biyya Brazil Andre Janones, injifannoo filannoo pirezidaant Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva irratti gahee guddaa taphateera. Janones 'Waraana Lula' kan jedhamuun garaa 'WhatsApp' fayyadamuun, torbanneen dhumaa duula filannoo keessatti namoota miliyoona 11 ol ofitti qabuun deeggarsa Lula cimseera. Mala midiyaa hawaasaa irratti fayyadame kanaan, duulli Lula rakkoo keessa ture akka deebi'ee cimuuf gargaareera.

title: Oman calls for Gulf, Iraq and Iran to unite under one security pact
english: Omani Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi has proposed a new non-aggression security pact involving Gulf states, Iraq, and Iran to promote regional independence. He argued that the region must stop relying on external powers like the US and instead create a unified framework that includes Iran. According to Busaidi, viewing Iran as a permanent enemy is a harmful misconception that undermines long-term stability and regional cooperation.
amharic: የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ባድር አል-ቡሳይዲ የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት፣ ኢራቅ እና ኢራን ክልላዊ ደህንነታቸውን በራሳቸው እንዲቆጣጠሩ የሚያስችል አዲስ የጋራ ስምምነት እንዲፈጥሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሚኒስትሩ አገራቱ ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጥገኝነት በመውጣት፣ ኢራንን ያካተተ የተረጋጋ የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ መዘርጋት እንዳለባቸው አስረድተዋል። ኢራንን እንደ ጠላት መመልከት ለክልሉ መረጋጋት ጎጂ የሆነ የተሳሳተ አመለካከት መሆኑንም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Omaan Badr al-Busaidi, biyyoonni Ganna Garba Pershiyaa, Iraaq fi Iraan nageenya isaanii ofii isaaniitiin akka eeggatan walta'iinsa nageenyaa haaraa akka uuman gaafataniiru. Mootummoonni kunneen hirkattummaa humnoota alaa irraa bilisa bahuun, Iraanis kan keessatti argamtu mootummaa nageenyaa waliinii diriirsuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Busaidi akka jedhanitti, Iraan diina dhaabbataa godhanii fudhachuun yaada dogoggoraa kan biyyoota sanaaf miidhaa qabu dha.

title: Smotrich says ‘Arab turnout unprecedented’
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called on right-wing supporters to vote, warning that high participation among Arab citizens could lead to a left-wing government. He urged his base to remain hopeful about their chances of winning despite the current electoral trends. Palestinian politicians have criticized these remarks, labeling them as incitement against the Arab minority population.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር በጻሌል ስሞትሪች፣ በአረብ ተወላጅ እስራኤላውያን በኩል እየታየ ያለው ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ የግራ ዘመም መንግስትን ስልጣን ላይ ሊያወጣ ይችላል በሚል የቀኝ ዘመም ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ድምጽ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል። በምርጫው ማሸነፍ እንደሚቻል ለደጋፊዎቻቸው የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ ይህ ንግግራቸው በሀገሪቱ አረብ ተወላጆች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅስቀሳ ነው በሚል ከፍ ያለ ትችት ገጥሞታል። የአረብ ተወላጆች የእስራኤልን ህዝብ 20 በመቶ ይሸፍናሉ።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, lammiileen Israa'el kanneen Arabummaa qaban sagalee kennuuf gara saanduqa filannoo ba'uun isaanii mootummaa gara bitaatti madaatu gara aangootti fiduu danda'a jechuun deggertoota isaanii qilleensatti waameera. Ministirichi deggertoota isaa filannoo kanatti injifachuu akka danda'an yaadachiiseera. Haata'u malee, siyaasaonni Arabootaa gochi kun lammiilee Israa'el kanneen biyyattii keessa jiraatan irratti kaayyoo gaarii hin qabneefi doorsisa jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Ra’am says Israeli police seized ballot boxes in Negev
english: The Ra’am party has reported that Israeli police confiscated ballot boxes in the Negev town of Arara. Authorities have also halted the voting process in that specific electoral district. This action has effectively disrupted the local election activities.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ የኢትዮጵያ ፖሊስ በኔጌቭ በምትገኘው አራራ ከተማ የምርጫ ሳጥኖችን መውሰዱን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም የጸጥታ ሃይሎች በዚያ አካባቢ የሚካሄደውን የምርጫ ሂደት እንዲቆም ማድረጋቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው የሚካሄደውን የምርጫ ሂደት ሙሉ ለሙሉ አቋርጦታል።
oromo: Paartiin Ra’am akka gabaasetti, poolisiin Israa’el magaalaa Araraa, kan Naagev keessatti argamtu keessatti sanduuqota sagalee fudhataniiru. Kana malees, qaamoleen nageenyaa naannoo sanaatti adeemsi filannoo akka dhaabbatu godhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun adeemsa filannoo naannichaa guutummaatti addaan kutee jira.

title: Ra’am’s Abbas calls for sustained voting to ‘bring down’ Netanyahu
english: Mansour Abbas, leader of the Ra'am party, has urged citizens to vote in the upcoming election to help remove Benjamin Netanyahu and his right-wing allies from power. He accused Netanyahu of using his party as a political distraction to energize right-wing voters. Abbas emphasized that strong voter turnout is the key to defeating the current government leadership.
amharic: የራአም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስ፣ ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እና አጋሮቻቸውን ከስልጣን ለማስወገድ በአዲሱ ምርጫ ላይ በስፋት እንዲሳተፉ እና ድምፅ እንዲሰጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ኔታንያሁ የራአም ፓርቲን የቀኝ ዘመም ደጋፊዎቹን ለማነሳሳት እንደ መጠቀሚያ እየተጠቀሙበት እንደሆነም ተችተዋል። አባስ፣ የምርጫውን ውጤት በመቀየር የአሁኑን መንግስት ለመጣል ብቸኛው መንገድ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ድምፅ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Ra'am, Mansuur Abbaas, filannoo dhufu irratti sagalee kennuun mootummaa Binyamin Netanyaahuu fi deggertoota isaa aangoo irraa kaasuun akka danda'amu ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun paartii isaanii kun namoota kaayyoo isaanii deggaran kakaasuuf akka malaatti itti fayyadamaa akka jiru himatanii jiru. Abbaas, mootummaa ammaa kana injifachuuf sagaleen uummataa murteessaa ta'uu isaa hubachiisaniiru.

title: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
english: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
